description: Source code for BufferedTextOutput class implementing buffered text output with thread safety, buffer management, and indentation/bundling features in Android.

classes.name: BufferedTextOutput::BufferState
classes.description: Manages individual buffer state including buffer memory, position, size, indentation, and bundling status.

classes.name: BufferedTextOutput::ThreadState
classes.description: Holds thread-local vector of BufferState instances for thread safety.

methods.name: BufferedTextOutput::print
methods.description: Outputs text to buffer, handling newlines, indentation, and bundling logic.

methods.name: BufferedTextOutput::pushBundle
methods.description: Starts a new bundle of output.

methods.name: BufferedTextOutput::popBundle
methods.description: Ends a bundle of output, optionally flushing buffer if bundle is complete.

methods.name: BufferedTextOutput::getBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate BufferState, considering thread safety if enabled.
